fr.title: Accumulation des dettes sur carte de crédit : ce que les soldes records révèlent sur le budget des ménages pendant les fêtes

segments.src: Every November, the same two things collide: retailers roll out their biggest sales of the year, and households take stock of how much room they really have in their budgets.
segments.tr: Chaque mois de novembre, les deux mêmes événements se télescopent : les détaillants lancent leurs plus grandes promotions de l'année, et les ménages font le point sur la marge de manœuvre dont ils disposent réellement dans leur budget.

segments.src: This year, the backdrop is a credit card debt load that has repeatedly set new records.
segments.tr: Cette année, le contexte est marqué par un niveau d'endettement par carte de crédit qui n'a cessé d'atteindre de nouveaux sommets.

segments.src: Here is what the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt data show, how card interest rates compare with earlier years, and what it all means for families heading into December.
segments.tr: Voici ce que montrent les données sur la dette des ménages de la Banque de la Réserve fédérale de New York, comment les taux d'intérêt des cartes se comparent à ceux des années précédentes, et ce que tout cela signifie pour les familles à l'approche du mois de décembre.

segments.src: ## What the New York Fed data show
segments.tr: ## Ce que montrent les données de la Fed de New York

segments.src: The New York Fed's Center for Microeconomic Data publishes the *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, based on anonymized credit bureau records.
segments.tr: Le Center for Microeconomic Data de la Fed de New York publie le *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, basé sur des données anonymisées des bureaux de crédit.

segments.src: It is one of the most widely cited gauges of how American households are borrowing.
segments.tr: C'est l'un des indicateurs les plus largement cités pour mesurer l'endettement des ménages américains.

segments.src: Some of the broad patterns in recent reports:
segments.tr: Voici quelques-unes des grandes tendances qui ressortent des récents rapports :

segments.src: - **Total household debt has climbed steadily.** In the third quarter of 2025, the report put total household debt at roughly $18.6 trillion, with mortgages making up the largest share.
segments.tr: - **La dette totale des ménages a progressé de manière constante.** Au troisième trimestre 2025, le rapport évaluait la dette totale des ménages à environ $18.6 trillions, les prêts hypothécaires en représentant la part la plus importante.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances sit above $1.2 trillion.** Balances crossed the $1 trillion mark in 2023 and have stayed above it since. Third-quarter 2025 figures were around $1.23 trillion.
segments.tr: - **Les soldes des cartes de crédit dépassent $1.2 trillion.** Les encours ont franchi le seuil du $1 trillion en 2023 et sont restés au-dessus depuis. Les chiffres du troisième trimestre 2025 s'élevaient à environ $1.23 trillion.

segments.src: - **Balances follow a seasonal rhythm.** Card balances usually dip in the first quarter, as people pay down holiday spending with tax refunds and bonuses, then rise through the year and peak around the end of the year.
segments.tr: - **Les soldes suivent un rythme saisonnier.** Les encours des cartes baissent généralement au premier trimestre, lorsque les ménages remboursent leurs dépenses de fin d'année grâce aux remboursements d'impôts et aux primes, puis ils augmentent tout au long de l'année pour atteindre un pic vers la fin de l'année.

segments.src: Readers should check the most recent release on the New York Fed's website for current figures.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs sont invités à consulter la publication la plus récente sur le site web de la Fed de New York pour connaître les chiffres actuels.

segments.src: The report is updated each quarter, and the numbers above are best read as a snapshot of the trend rather than the latest data point.
segments.tr: Le rapport est mis à jour chaque trimestre, et les chiffres ci-dessus doivent être interprétés comme un aperçu de la tendance plutôt que comme une valeur actualisée.

segments.src: ### Records in dollars are not always records in strain
segments.tr: ### Des records en dollars ne traduisent pas toujours une détérioration de la situation financière

segments.src: A large share of the "record" headlines reflects simple arithmetic.
segments.tr: Une grande partie des titres annonçant des « records » relève d'une simple arithmétique.

segments.src: Prices are higher than they were a few years ago, the population has grown, and incomes have risen in nominal terms.
segments.tr: Les prix sont plus élevés qu'il y a quelques années, la population a augmenté et les revenus ont progressé en termes nominaux.

segments.src: A bigger economy tends to carry bigger balances.
segments.tr: Une économie plus vaste tend à porter des encours plus élevés.

segments.src: Many cardholders also pay their bills in full every month, so a rising balance total does not automatically mean more households are in trouble.
segments.tr: De nombreux titulaires de cartes règlent également l'intégralité de leurs factures chaque mois ; ainsi, une hausse du solde total ne signifie pas automatiquement qu'un plus grand nombre de ménages est en difficulté.

segments.src: The more telling signals sit underneath the headline number.
segments.tr: Les signaux les plus révélateurs se trouvent sous ce chiffre global.

segments.src: These include the share of balances that are delinquent, how many borrowers carry a balance from month to month, and how fast new delinquencies are appearing.
segments.tr: Il s'agit notamment de la proportion de soldes en impayés, du nombre d'emprunteurs reportant un solde d'un mois sur l'autre et de la vitesse à laquelle apparaissent les nouveaux retards de paiement.

segments.src: ## Delinquencies: where the stress shows up
segments.tr: ## Retards de paiement : là où les tensions se manifestent

segments.src: The New York Fed also tracks how many borrowers fall behind on payments.
segments.tr: La Fed de New York suit également le nombre d'emprunteurs en retard dans leurs règlements.

segments.src: Credit cards have consistently shown some of the highest delinquency transition rates among major debt types.
segments.tr: Les cartes de crédit ont systématiquement affiché l'un des taux de transition vers le retard de paiement les plus élevés parmi les principaux types de dettes.

segments.src: In recent reports, a meaningful share of card balances moved into serious delinquency (90 or more days past due) within a year.
segments.tr: Dans les rapports récents, une part significative des encours de cartes est passée en impayé grave (retard de 90 jours ou plus) en l'espace d'un an.

segments.src: That share is higher than the period just before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Cette proportion est plus élevée qu'au cours de la période précédant immédiatement la pandémie.

segments.src: Younger borrowers and those in lower-income areas have generally shown more strain than older and higher-income groups.
segments.tr: Les emprunteurs plus jeunes et ceux des zones à faibles revenus ont généralement fait preuve de plus de vulnérabilité que les groupes plus âgés ou disposant de revenus plus élevés.

segments.src: That uneven pattern matters.
segments.tr: Cette disparité est importante.

segments.src: Overall averages can look manageable while a sizeable group of households is stretched thin.
segments.tr: Les moyennes globales peuvent sembler soutenables alors même qu'un groupe restreint mais significatif de ménages se retrouve sous très forte pression financière.

segments.src: ## How card interest rates compare with past years
segments.tr: ## Comparaison des taux d'intérêt des cartes avec les années passées

segments.src: The cost of carrying a balance is where the story gets more pressing.
segments.tr: C'est lorsqu'on examine le coût du report de solde que la situation devient plus préoccupante.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data on interest rates for credit card accounts that are assessed interest have shown average rates in the low 20-percent range in recent years.
segments.tr: Les données de la Réserve fédérale sur les taux d'intérêt des comptes de cartes de crédit soumis à des agios indiquent des taux moyens situés dans le bas de la fourchette des 20 % ces dernières années.

segments.src: Industry trackers report averages near 20 percent for new offers.
segments.tr: Les organismes d'analyse du secteur font état de moyennes proches de 20 % pour les nouvelles offres.

segments.src: By comparison:
segments.tr: À titre de comparaison :

segments.src: - In the years after the 2008 financial crisis and through the 2010s, average card rates were typically in the low-to-mid teens.
segments.tr: - Dans les années qui ont suivi la crise financière de 2008 et tout au long des années 2010, les taux moyens des cartes se situaient généralement dans une fourchette allant du bas au milieu de la dizaine de pourcents.

segments.src: - In 2021, when the Fed held its benchmark rate near zero, the average rate on interest-bearing accounts dipped to roughly 14 to 15 percent.
segments.tr: - En 2021, lorsque la Fed maintenait son taux directeur proche de zéro, le taux moyen sur les comptes portant intérêt est descendu à environ 14 à 15 %.

segments.src: - After the Fed began raising rates sharply in 2022, card APRs followed. Most cards carry variable rates tied to the prime rate, so they adjust quickly when the Fed moves.
segments.tr: - Après que la Fed a commencé à relever ses taux brutalement en 2022, les APR (taux annuels effectifs globaux) des cartes ont suivi. La plupart des cartes appliquent des taux variables adossés au taux d'intérêt préférentiel (prime rate), de sorte qu'ils s'ajustent rapidement aux décisions de la Fed.

segments.src: Card APRs have eased only slightly from their peak, even as the Fed has trimmed its benchmark rate.
segments.tr: Les APR des cartes n'ont que légèrement diminué par rapport à leur sommet, même si la Fed a abaissé son taux directeur.

segments.src: Because issuers set their own margins above the prime rate, a rate cut does not translate into a matching drop for cardholders.
segments.tr: Puisque les émetteurs fixent leurs propres marges au-dessus du prime rate, une baisse des taux ne se traduit pas par une réduction équivalente pour les titulaires de cartes.

segments.src: ### What a 21 percent APR means in practice
segments.tr: ### Ce qu'un APR de 21 % signifie en pratique

segments.src: Consider a household carrying a $5,000 balance at an APR of about 21 percent.
segments.tr: Prenons le cas d'un ménage ayant un solde de $5,000 avec un APR d'environ 21 %.

segments.src: Making only a minimum payment, interest alone could add roughly $85 to $90 a month early on.
segments.tr: En ne versant que le paiement minimum, les seuls intérêts peuvent ajouter environ $85 à $90 par mois au début.

segments.src: The balance falls slowly, and the payoff stretches across many years.
segments.tr: Le solde ne diminue que très lentement, et l'apurement s'étale sur de nombreuses années.

segments.src: At a rate of 14 percent, the same balance would cost noticeably less in interest each month.
segments.tr: À un taux de 14 %, ce même solde coûterait nettement moins cher en intérêts chaque mois.

segments.src: The gap is small in any single month, but it compounds into hundreds or thousands of dollars over time.
segments.tr: L'écart est minime sur un seul mois, mais il se cumule pour atteindre des centaines, voire des milliers de dollars au fil du temps.

segments.src: ## Why the holidays raise the stakes
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi la période des fêtes accentue les enjeux

segments.src: Seasonal spending adds pressure at an already tight time.
segments.tr: Les dépenses saisonnières ajoutent de la pression à un moment déjà tendu.

segments.src: A few factors stand out:
segments.tr: Quelques facteurs se détachent :

segments.src: 1. **Holiday spending is large and concentrated.** The National Retail Federation and other groups have projected total holiday retail sales in the trillions of dollars in recent seasons. Much of that lands on cards over a few weeks.
segments.tr: 1. **Les dépenses de fin d'année sont volumineuses et concentrées.** La National Retail Federation et d'autres organismes ont estimé les ventes au détail de fin d'année à plusieurs trillions de dollars lors des saisons récentes. Une grande partie de ces montants est imputée sur les cartes en l'espace de quelques semaines.

segments.src: 2. **Buy now, pay later is part of the mix.** Installment plans can spread out costs, but they add another set of due dates on top of card payments.
segments.tr: 2. **Le paiement en plusieurs fois (BNPL) fait partie du décor.** Les formules d'échéancier permettent de répartir les coûts, mais elles ajoutent d'autres dates de paiement en plus des mensualités de cartes.

segments.src: 3. **Prices remain a concern.** Even with inflation cooler than its 2022 peak, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher costs for groceries, housing, insurance, and utilities. Less slack in the monthly budget leaves less room for gifts, travel, and hosting.
segments.tr: 3. **Les prix restent un sujet de préoccupation.** Même si l'inflation s'est modérée par rapport à son pic de 2022, de nombreux ménages subissent encore l'effet cumulé du coût élevé de l'alimentation, du logement, des assurances et des services publics. Moins de souplesse dans le budget mensuel laisse moins de marge pour les cadeaux, les voyages et la réception des proches.

segments.src: 4. **January bills arrive later.** Holiday charges often appear on statements in December and January, which is when many families first see the full total.
segments.tr: 4. **Les factures de janvier arrivent plus tard.** Les achats des fêtes apparaissent souvent sur les relevés de décembre et de janvier, moment où beaucoup de familles prennent conscience pour la première fois du montant total.

segments.src: ## What families heading into December can do
segments.tr: ## Ce que les familles préparant le mois de décembre peuvent faire

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic, and none of it is personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: Rien de tout cela ne doit susciter la panique, et rien de tout cela ne constitue un conseil financier personnalisé.

segments.src: But a few practical steps are widely recommended by consumer finance educators and nonprofit credit counselors:
segments.tr: Cependant, quelques mesures pratiques sont largement recommandées par les éducateurs en finances personnelles et les conseillers en crédit à but non lucratif :

segments.src: - **Set a spending ceiling before shopping.** Decide on a total for gifts, food, and travel, and work backward to per-person amounts.
segments.tr: - **Fixez un plafond de dépenses avant d'acheter.** Déterminez un montant total pour les cadeaux, le repas et les déplacements, puis calculez la somme disponible par personne.

segments.src: - **Know your APR and your balance.** Check your latest statement. If you already carry a balance, new holiday purchases will start accruing interest right away, because the grace period usually applies only when the balance is paid in full.
segments.tr: - **Connaissez votre APR et votre solde.** Vérifiez votre dernier relevé. Si vous reportez déjà un solde, les nouveaux achats des fêtes commenceront à produire des intérêts immédiatement, car la période de grâce ne s'applique généralement que lorsque le solde est entièrement réglé.

segments.src: - **Prioritize the highest-rate debt.** Paying more than the minimum on the highest-APR card generally saves the most in interest.
segments.tr: - **Accordez la priorité aux dettes dont le taux est le plus élevé.** Payer plus que le minimum sur la carte ayant l'APR le plus élevé permet généralement de réaliser les économies d'intérêts les plus importantes.

segments.src: - **Look at balance transfer or consolidation options carefully.** Introductory 0 percent offers can help, but transfer fees, the length of the promotional period, and the rate that applies afterward all matter.
segments.tr: - **Examinez attentivement les options de transfert de solde ou de consolidation.** Les offres promotionnelles à 0 % peuvent vous aider, mais les frais de transfert, la durée de la période promotionnelle et le taux applicable par la suite sont des éléments clés à prendre en compte.

segments.src: - **Contact your issuer if you are struggling.** Some issuers offer hardship programs. Nonprofit credit counseling agencies, including members of the National Foundation for Credit Counseling, can also help build a repayment plan.
segments.tr: - **Contactez votre émetteur en cas de difficulté.** Certains émetteurs proposent des programmes d'aide aux emprunteurs en difficulté. Des organismes de conseil en crédit à but non lucratif, comme les membres de la National Foundation for Credit Counseling, peuvent également vous aider à établir un plan de remboursement.

segments.src: - **Use alerts and autopay for at least the minimum.** A missed payment can bring late fees and a penalty rate, and it can hurt your credit score.
segments.tr: - **Activez les alertes et le prélèvement automatique au moins pour le paiement minimum.** Un retard de paiement peut engendrer des pénalités de retard, un taux majoré et dégrader votre score de crédit.

segments.src: - **Consider a smaller January.** A few gift-giving traditions, such as homemade gifts, shared experiences, or a set exchange, can lower the total without lowering the spirit of the season.
segments.tr: - **Envisagez un mois de janvier plus modeste.** Quelques traditions de cadeaux adaptées — comme des cadeaux faits maison, des activités partagées ou un tirage au sort (Secret Santa) — permettent d'alléger le budget tout en préservant l'esprit des fêtes.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture
segments.tr: ## Une vue d'ensemble

segments.src: Record card balances are the product of several overlapping forces: higher prices, a larger economy, resilient consumer spending, and borrowing costs that remain well above their pandemic-era lows.
segments.tr: Les soldes de cartes de crédit record résultent de la combinaison de plusieurs facteurs : des prix plus élevés, une économie en croissance, une consommation résiliente des ménages et des coûts d'emprunt qui restent bien supérieurs à leurs plus bas niveaux de la période de pandémie.

segments.src: For many households, the numbers are manageable.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreux ménages, ces chiffres restent soutenables.

segments.src: For others, particularly those carrying balances month to month at rates above 20 percent, the holiday season can deepen a cycle that is hard to escape.
segments.tr: Pour d'autres, en particulier ceux qui reportent des soldes d'un mois sur l'autre à des taux dépassant 20 %, la période des fêtes risque de renforcer une spirale d'endettement difficile à enrayer.

segments.src: The most useful way to read the New York Fed's data is not as a single alarming figure but as a set of trends.
segments.tr: La manière la plus pertinente d'analyser les données de la Fed de New York consiste non pas à se focaliser sur un chiffre alarmant unique, mais à y lire un ensemble de tendances.

segments.src: Balances are high, borrowing is expensive, and delinquencies are elevated in some groups.
segments.tr: Les encours sont élevés, l'emprunt coûte cher et les retards de paiement augmentent au sein de certains groupes.

segments.src: Families who go into December with a plan, a clear view of their rates, and a realistic limit are in the best position to start the new year without a heavy debt hangover.
segments.tr: Les familles qui abordent le mois de décembre avec un plan structuré, une vision claire de leurs taux et une limite réaliste seront les mieux armées pour démarrer la nouvelle année sans subir le poids d'un surendettement.

pt.title: Dívidas de cartão de crédito em alta: o que os saldos recordes dizem sobre os orçamentos familiares nesta temporada de festas

segments.src: Every November, the same two things collide: retailers roll out their biggest sales of the year, and households take stock of how much room they really have in their budgets.
segments.tr: Todo mês de novembro, duas coisas colidem: os varejistas lançam suas maiores promoções do ano e as famílias avaliam quanto espaço realmente têm em seus orçamentos.

segments.src: This year, the backdrop is a credit card debt load that has repeatedly set new records.
segments.tr: Este ano, o cenário é de uma carga de dívidas de cartão de crédito que tem estabelecido novos recordes repetidamente.

segments.src: Here is what the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt data show, how card interest rates compare with earlier years, and what it all means for families heading into December.
segments.tr: Aqui está o que os dados de dívida das famílias do Federal Reserve Bank de Nova York mostram, como as taxas de juros dos cartões se comparam com anos anteriores e o que tudo isso significa para as famílias que se aproximam de dezembro.

segments.src: ## What the New York Fed data show
segments.tr: ## O que os dados do Fed de Nova York mostram

segments.src: The New York Fed's Center for Microeconomic Data publishes the *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, based on anonymized credit bureau records.
segments.tr: O Centro de Dados Microeconômicos do Fed de Nova York publica o *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit* (Relatório Trimestral sobre Dívida e Crédito das Famílias), com base em registros anonimizados de agências de crédito.

segments.src: It is one of the most widely cited gauges of how American households are borrowing.
segments.tr: É um dos indicadores mais citados sobre como as famílias americanas estão tomando empréstimos.

segments.src: Some of the broad patterns in recent reports:
segments.tr: Alguns dos padrões gerais nos relatórios recentes:

segments.src: - **Total household debt has climbed steadily.** In the third quarter of 2025, the report put total household debt at roughly $18.6 trillion, with mortgages making up the largest share.
segments.tr: - **A dívida total das famílias tem subido constantemente.** No terceiro trimestre de 2025, o relatório situou a dívida total das famílias em aproximadamente US$ 18,6 trilhões, sendo que as hipotecas representam a maior parte.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances sit above $1.2 trillion.** Balances crossed the $1 trillion mark in 2023 and have stayed above it since. Third-quarter 2025 figures were around $1.23 trillion.
segments.tr: - **Os saldos de cartões de crédito estão acima de US$ 1,2 trilhão.** Os saldos ultrapassaram a marca de US$ 1 trilhão em 2023 e permaneceram acima dela desde então. Os números do terceiro trimestre de 2025 ficaram em torno de US$ 1,23 trilhão.

segments.src: - **Balances follow a seasonal rhythm.** Card balances usually dip in the first quarter, as people pay down holiday spending with tax refunds and bonuses, then rise through the year and peak around the end of the year.
segments.tr: - **Os saldos seguem um ritmo sazonal.** Os saldos dos cartões geralmente caem no primeiro trimestre, à medida que as pessoas pagam os gastos das festas com restituições de impostos e bônus, depois sobem ao longo do ano e atingem o pico perto do final do ano.

segments.src: Readers should check the most recent release on the New York Fed's website for current figures.
segments.tr: Os leitores devem verificar a versão mais recente no site do Fed de Nova York para obter os números atuais.

segments.src: The report is updated each quarter, and the numbers above are best read as a snapshot of the trend rather than the latest data point.
segments.tr: O relatório é atualizado a cada trimestre, e os números acima devem ser lidos como um retrato da tendência, em vez do ponto de dados mais recente.

segments.tr: 1. **Os gastos de fim de ano são grandes e concentrados.** A National Retail Federation e outros grupos projetaram vendas totais no varejo de fim de ano na casa dos trilhões de dólares nas temporadas recentes. Grande parte disso cai nos cartões ao longo de algumas semanas.

segments.src: 2. **Buy now, pay later is part of the mix.** Installment plans can spread out costs, but they add another set of due dates on top of card payments.
segments.tr: 2. **Compre agora, pague depois faz parte da mistura.** Planos de parcelamento podem distribuir os custos, mas adicionam outro conjunto de datas de vencimento além dos pagamentos do cartão.

segments.src: 3. **Prices remain a concern.** Even with inflation cooler than its 2022 peak, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher costs for groceries, housing, insurance, and utilities. Less slack in the monthly budget leaves less room for gifts, travel, and hosting.
segments.tr: 3. **Os preços continuam sendo uma preocupação.** Mesmo com a inflação mais baixa do que o pico de 2022, muitas famílias ainda sentem o efeito cumulativo de custos mais altos com supermercado, moradia, seguros e serviços públicos. Menos folga no orçamento mensal deixa menos espaço para presentes, viagens e recepções.

segments.src: 4. **January bills arrive later.** Holiday charges often appear on statements in December and January, which is when many families first see the full total.
segments.tr: 4. **As contas de janeiro chegam mais tarde.** As cobranças de fim de ano geralmente aparecem nos extratos em dezembro e janeiro, que é quando muitas famílias veem o total completo pela primeira vez.

segments.src: ## What families heading into December can do
segments.tr: ## O que as famílias que se aproximam de dezembro podem fazer

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic, and none of it is personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: Nada disso é motivo para pânico, e nada disso é aconselhamento financeiro personalizado.

segments.src: But a few practical steps are widely recommended by consumer finance educators and nonprofit credit counselors:
segments.tr: Mas alguns passos práticos são amplamente recomendados por educadores financeiros e conselheiros de crédito sem fins lucrativos:

segments.src: - **Set a spending ceiling before shopping.** Decide on a total for gifts, food, and travel, and work backward to per-person amounts.
segments.tr: - **Defina um teto de gastos antes de comprar.** Decida um total para presentes, comida e viagens, e trabalhe de trás para frente até chegar aos valores por pessoa.

segments.src: - **Know your APR and your balance.** Check your latest statement. If you already carry a balance, new holiday purchases will start accruing interest right away, because the grace period usually applies only when the balance is paid in full.
segments.tr: - **Conheça sua APR e seu saldo.** Verifique seu extrato mais recente. Se você já tem um saldo, as novas compras de fim de ano começarão a acumular juros imediatamente, porque o período de carência geralmente se aplica apenas quando o saldo é pago integralmente.

segments.src: - **Prioritize the highest-rate debt.** Paying more than the minimum on the highest-APR card generally saves the most in interest.
segments.tr: - **Priorize a dívida com a taxa mais alta.** Pagar mais do que o mínimo no cartão com a maior APR geralmente economiza mais em juros.

segments.src: - **Look at balance transfer or consolidation options carefully.** Introductory 0 percent offers can help, but transfer fees, the length of the promotional period, and the rate that applies afterward all matter.
segments.tr: - **Analise cuidadosamente as opções de transferência de saldo ou consolidação.** Ofertas introdutórias de 0 por cento podem ajudar, mas taxas de transferência, a duração do período promocional e a taxa que se aplica depois são importantes.

segments.src: - **Contact your issuer if you are struggling.** Some issuers offer hardship programs. Nonprofit credit counseling agencies, including members of the National Foundation for Credit Counseling, can also help build a repayment plan.
segments.tr: - **Entre em contato com seu emissor se estiver com dificuldades.** Alguns emissores oferecem programas de auxílio. Agências de aconselhamento de crédito sem fins lucrativos, incluindo membros da National Foundation for Credit Counseling, também podem ajudar a criar um plano de pagamento.

segments.src: - **Use alerts and autopay for at least the minimum.** A missed payment can bring late fees and a penalty rate, and it can hurt your credit score.
segments.tr: - **Use alertas e pagamento automático pelo menos para o mínimo.** Um pagamento perdido pode trazer taxas de atraso e uma taxa de penalidade, e pode prejudicar sua pontuação de crédito.

segments.src: - **Consider a smaller January.** A few gift-giving traditions, such as homemade gifts, shared experiences, or a set exchange, can lower the total without lowering the spirit of the season.
segments.tr: - **Considere um janeiro mais modesto.** Algumas tradições de troca de presentes, como presentes feitos à mão, experiências compartilhadas ou um sorteio, podem reduzir o total sem diminuir o espírito da temporada.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture
segments.tr: ## O cenário geral

segments.src: Record card balances are the product of several overlapping forces: higher prices, a larger economy, resilient consumer spending, and borrowing costs that remain well above their pandemic-era lows.
segments.tr: Os saldos recordes de cartão são o produto de várias forças sobrepostas: preços mais altos, uma economia maior, gastos resilientes do consumidor e custos de empréstimos que permanecem bem acima de suas mínimas da era da pandemia.

segments.src: For many households, the numbers are manageable.
segments.tr: Para muitas famílias, os números são administráveis.

segments.src: For others, particularly those carrying balances month to month at rates above 20 percent, the holiday season can deepen a cycle that is hard to escape.
segments.tr: Para outras, particularmente aquelas que carregam saldos de mês a mês a taxas acima de 20 por cento, a temporada de festas pode aprofundar um ciclo do qual é difícil escapar.

segments.src: The most useful way to read the New York Fed's data is not as a single alarming figure but as a set of trends.
segments.tr: A maneira mais útil de ler os dados do Fed de Nova York não é como um único número alarmante, mas como um conjunto de tendências.

segments.src: Balances are high, borrowing is expensive, and delinquencies are elevated in some groups.
segments.tr: Os saldos estão altos, os empréstimos estão caros e a inadimplência está elevada em alguns grupos.

in.title: Tumpukan Utang Kartu Kredit: Apa Arti Rekor Saldo Kartu Kredit bagi Anggaran Rumah Tangga di Musim Liburan Ini

segments.src: Every November, the same two things collide: retailers roll out their biggest sales of the year, and households take stock of how much room they really have in their budgets.
segments.tr: Setiap bulan November, dua hal yang sama terjadi bersamaan: peritel meluncurkan diskon terbesar mereka tahun ini, dan rumah tangga mulai menghitung seberapa besar ruang yang sebenarnya mereka miliki dalam anggaran mereka.

segments.src: This year, the backdrop is a credit card debt load that has repeatedly set new records.
segments.tr: Tahun ini, latar belakangnya adalah beban utang kartu kredit yang berulang kali mencetak rekor baru.

segments.src: Here is what the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt data show, how card interest rates compare with earlier years, and what it all means for families heading into December.
segments.tr: Berikut adalah apa yang ditunjukkan oleh data utang rumah tangga dari Federal Reserve Bank of New York, bagaimana suku bunga kartu dibandingkan dengan tahun-tahun sebelumnya, dan apa artinya bagi keluarga yang memasuki bulan Desember.

segments.src: ## What the New York Fed data show
segments.tr: ## Apa yang ditunjukkan oleh data New York Fed

segments.src: The New York Fed's Center for Microeconomic Data publishes the *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, based on anonymized credit bureau records.
segments.tr: Center for Microeconomic Data milik New York Fed menerbitkan *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, berdasarkan catatan biro kredit yang dianonimkan.

segments.src: It is one of the most widely cited gauges of how American households are borrowing.
segments.tr: Ini adalah salah satu tolok ukur yang paling banyak dikutip tentang bagaimana rumah tangga Amerika meminjam uang.

segments.src: Some of the broad patterns in recent reports:
segments.tr: Beberapa pola umum dalam laporan terbaru:

segments.src: - **Total household debt has climbed steadily.** In the third quarter of 2025, the report put total household debt at roughly $18.6 trillion, with mortgages making up the largest share.
segments.tr: - **Total utang rumah tangga terus meningkat.** Pada kuartal ketiga tahun 2025, laporan tersebut mencatat total utang rumah tangga sekitar $18,6 triliun, dengan hipotek menyumbang bagian terbesar.

segments.src: - **Credit card balances sit above $1.2 trillion.** Balances crossed the $1 trillion mark in 2023 and have stayed above it since. Third-quarter 2025 figures were around $1.23 trillion.
segments.tr: - **Saldo kartu kredit berada di atas $1,2 triliun.** Saldo melewati angka $1 triliun pada tahun 2023 dan tetap di atasnya sejak saat itu. Angka kuartal ketiga tahun 2025 berada di sekitar $1,23 triliun.

segments.src: - **Balances follow a seasonal rhythm.** Card balances usually dip in the first quarter, as people pay down holiday spending with tax refunds and bonuses, then rise through the year and peak around the end of the year.
segments.tr: - **Saldo mengikuti ritme musiman.** Saldo kartu biasanya turun pada kuartal pertama, karena orang membayar pengeluaran liburan dengan pengembalian pajak dan bonus, kemudian naik sepanjang tahun dan mencapai puncaknya menjelang akhir tahun.

segments.src: Readers should check the most recent release on the New York Fed's website for current figures.
segments.tr: Pembaca harus memeriksa rilis terbaru di situs web New York Fed untuk angka terkini.

segments.src: The report is updated each quarter, and the numbers above are best read as a snapshot of the trend rather than the latest data point.
segments.tr: Laporan ini diperbarui setiap kuartal, dan angka-angka di atas paling baik dibaca sebagai potret tren daripada titik data terbaru.

segments.src: ### Records in dollars are not always records in strain
segments.tr: ### Rekor dalam dolar tidak selalu berarti rekor dalam tekanan

segments.src: A large share of the "record" headlines reflects simple arithmetic.
segments.tr: Sebagian besar tajuk berita "rekor" mencerminkan aritmatika sederhana.

segments.src: Prices are higher than they were a few years ago, the population has grown, and incomes have risen in nominal terms.
segments.tr: Harga lebih tinggi daripada beberapa tahun yang lalu, populasi telah bertambah, dan pendapatan telah meningkat secara nominal.

segments.src: A bigger economy tends to carry bigger balances.
segments.tr: Ekonomi yang lebih besar cenderung membawa saldo yang lebih besar.

segments.src: Many cardholders also pay their bills in full every month, so a rising balance total does not automatically mean more households are in trouble.
segments.tr: Banyak pemegang kartu juga membayar tagihan mereka secara penuh setiap bulan, jadi total saldo yang meningkat tidak secara otomatis berarti lebih banyak rumah tangga yang dalam masalah.

segments.src: The more telling signals sit underneath the headline number.
segments.tr: Sinyal yang lebih jelas terletak di bawah angka utama.

segments.src: These include the share of balances that are delinquent, how many borrowers carry a balance from month to month, and how fast new delinquencies are appearing.
segments.tr: Ini termasuk bagian saldo yang menunggak, berapa banyak peminjam yang membawa saldo dari bulan ke bulan, dan seberapa cepat tunggakan baru muncul.

segments.src: ## Delinquencies: where the stress shows up
segments.tr: ## Tunggakan: di mana tekanan muncul

segments.src: The New York Fed also tracks how many borrowers fall behind on payments.
segments.tr: New York Fed juga melacak berapa banyak peminjam yang terlambat melakukan pembayaran.

segments.src: Credit cards have consistently shown some of the highest delinquency transition rates among major debt types.
segments.tr: Kartu kredit secara konsisten menunjukkan beberapa tingkat transisi tunggakan tertinggi di antara jenis utang utama.

segments.src: In recent reports, a meaningful share of card balances moved into serious delinquency (90 or more days past due) within a year.
segments.tr: Dalam laporan terbaru, bagian yang berarti dari saldo kartu berpindah ke tunggakan serius (90 hari atau lebih lewat jatuh tempo) dalam setahun.

segments.src: That share is higher than the period just before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Bagian itu lebih tinggi daripada periode tepat sebelum pandemi.

segments.src: Younger borrowers and those in lower-income areas have generally shown more strain than older and higher-income groups.
segments.tr: Peminjam yang lebih muda dan mereka yang berada di daerah berpenghasilan rendah umumnya menunjukkan lebih banyak tekanan daripada kelompok yang lebih tua dan berpenghasilan lebih tinggi.

segments.src: That uneven pattern matters.
segments.tr: Pola yang tidak merata itu penting.

segments.src: Overall averages can look manageable while a sizeable group of households is stretched thin.
segments.tr: Rata-rata keseluruhan bisa terlihat terkendali sementara sekelompok besar rumah tangga berada dalam kondisi tertekan.

segments.src: ## How card interest rates compare with past years
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana suku bunga kartu dibandingkan dengan tahun-tahun sebelumnya

segments.src: The cost of carrying a balance is where the story gets more pressing.
segments.tr: Biaya membawa saldo adalah bagian di mana ceritanya menjadi lebih mendesak.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data on interest rates for credit card accounts that are assessed interest have shown average rates in the low 20-percent range in recent years.
segments.tr: Data Federal Reserve tentang suku bunga untuk akun kartu kredit yang dikenakan bunga telah menunjukkan suku bunga rata-rata di kisaran 20-persen rendah dalam beberapa tahun terakhir.

segments.src: Industry trackers report averages near 20 percent for new offers.
segments.tr: Pelacak industri melaporkan rata-rata mendekati 20 persen untuk penawaran baru.

segments.src: By comparison:
segments.tr: Sebagai perbandingan:

segments.src: - In the years after the 2008 financial crisis and through the 2010s, average card rates were typically in the low-to-mid teens.
segments.tr: - Pada tahun-tahun setelah krisis keuangan 2008 dan sepanjang tahun 2010-an, suku bunga kartu rata-rata biasanya berada di angka belasan rendah hingga menengah.

segments.src: - In 2021, when the Fed held its benchmark rate near zero, the average rate on interest-bearing accounts dipped to roughly 14 to 15 percent.
segments.tr: - Pada tahun 2021, ketika Fed menahan suku bunga acuannya mendekati nol, suku bunga rata-rata pada akun berbunga turun menjadi sekitar 14 hingga 15 persen.

segments.src: - After the Fed began raising rates sharply in 2022, card APRs followed. Most cards carry variable rates tied to the prime rate, so they adjust quickly when the Fed moves.
segments.tr: - Setelah Fed mulai menaikkan suku bunga secara tajam pada tahun 2022, APR kartu mengikuti. Sebagian besar kartu memiliki suku bunga variabel yang terikat pada suku bunga utama (prime rate), sehingga mereka menyesuaikan dengan cepat ketika Fed bergerak.

segments.src: Card APRs have eased only slightly from their peak, even as the Fed has trimmed its benchmark rate.
segments.tr: APR kartu hanya sedikit melunak dari puncaknya, bahkan ketika Fed telah memangkas suku bunga acuannya.

segments.src: Because issuers set their own margins above the prime rate, a rate cut does not translate into a matching drop for cardholders.
segments.tr: Karena penerbit menetapkan margin mereka sendiri di atas suku bunga utama, pemotongan suku bunga tidak diterjemahkan menjadi penurunan yang setara bagi pemegang kartu.

segments.src: ### What a 21 percent APR means in practice
segments.tr: ### Apa arti APR 21 persen dalam praktiknya

segments.src: Consider a household carrying a $5,000 balance at an APR of about 21 percent.
segments.tr: Pertimbangkan rumah tangga yang membawa saldo $5.000 dengan APR sekitar 21 persen.

segments.src: Making only a minimum payment, interest alone could add roughly $85 to $90 a month early on.
segments.tr: Hanya melakukan pembayaran minimum, bunga saja bisa menambah sekitar $85 hingga $90 per bulan di awal.

segments.src: The balance falls slowly, and the payoff stretches across many years.
segments.tr: Saldo turun perlahan, dan pelunasan berlangsung selama bertahun-tahun.

segments.src: At a rate of 14 percent, the same balance would cost noticeably less in interest each month.
segments.tr: Pada tingkat 14 persen, saldo yang sama akan memakan biaya bunga yang jauh lebih sedikit setiap bulan.

segments.src: The gap is small in any single month, but it compounds into hundreds or thousands of dollars over time.
segments.tr: Kesenjangannya kecil dalam satu bulan, tetapi terakumulasi menjadi ratusan atau ribuan dolar seiring waktu.

segments.src: ## Why the holidays raise the stakes
segments.tr: ## Mengapa liburan meningkatkan taruhan

segments.src: Seasonal spending adds pressure at an already tight time.
segments.tr: Pengeluaran musiman menambah tekanan pada waktu yang sudah ketat.

segments.src: A few factors stand out:
segments.tr: Beberapa faktor menonjol:

segments.src: 1. **Holiday spending is large and concentrated.** The National Retail Federation and other groups have projected total holiday retail sales in the trillions of dollars in recent seasons. Much of that lands on cards over a few weeks.
segments.tr: 1. **Pengeluaran liburan besar dan terkonsentrasi.** National Retail Federation dan kelompok lain telah memproyeksikan total penjualan ritel liburan dalam triliunan dolar dalam beberapa musim terakhir. Sebagian besar dari itu dibebankan pada kartu selama beberapa minggu.

segments.src: 2. **Buy now, pay later is part of the mix.** Installment plans can spread out costs, but they add another set of due dates on top of card payments.
segments.tr: 2. **Beli sekarang, bayar nanti adalah bagian dari campuran.** Rencana cicilan dapat menyebarkan biaya, tetapi mereka menambahkan serangkaian tanggal jatuh tempo lain di atas pembayaran kartu.

segments.src: 3. **Prices remain a concern.** Even with inflation cooler than its 2022 peak, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher costs for groceries, housing, insurance, and utilities. Less slack in the monthly budget leaves less room for gifts, travel, and hosting.
segments.tr: 3. **Harga tetap menjadi perhatian.** Bahkan dengan inflasi yang lebih dingin daripada puncaknya di tahun 2022, banyak rumah tangga masih merasakan efek kumulatif dari biaya yang lebih tinggi untuk bahan makanan, perumahan, asuransi, dan utilitas. Kurangnya kelonggaran dalam anggaran bulanan menyisakan lebih sedikit ruang untuk hadiah, perjalanan, dan menjamu tamu.

segments.src: 4. **January bills arrive later.** Holiday charges often appear on statements in December and January, which is when many families first see the full total.
segments.tr: 4. **Tagihan Januari datang terlambat.** Biaya liburan sering muncul di laporan pada bulan Desember dan Januari, saat itulah banyak keluarga pertama kali melihat total keseluruhannya.

segments.src: ## What families heading into December can do
segments.tr: ## Apa yang bisa dilakukan keluarga menjelang Desember

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic, and none of it is personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: Tidak ada dari semua ini yang menjadi alasan untuk panik, dan tidak ada dari ini yang merupakan saran keuangan yang dipersonalisasi.

segments.src: But a few practical steps are widely recommended by consumer finance educators and nonprofit credit counselors:
segments.tr: Tetapi beberapa langkah praktis secara luas direkomendasikan oleh pendidik keuangan konsumen dan konselor kredit nirlaba:

segments.src: - **Set a spending ceiling before shopping.** Decide on a total for gifts, food, and travel, and work backward to per-person amounts.
segments.tr: - **Tetapkan batas pengeluaran sebelum berbelanja.** Tentukan total untuk hadiah, makanan, dan perjalanan, dan hitung mundur ke jumlah per orang.

segments.src: - **Know your APR and your balance.** Check your latest statement. If you already carry a balance, new holiday purchases will start accruing interest right away, because the grace period usually applies only when the balance is paid in full.
segments.tr: - **Ketahui APR dan saldo Anda.** Periksa laporan terbaru Anda. Jika Anda sudah membawa saldo, pembelian liburan baru akan mulai dikenakan bunga segera, karena masa tenggang biasanya hanya berlaku jika saldo dibayar penuh.

segments.src: - **Prioritize the highest-rate debt.** Paying more than the minimum on the highest-APR card generally saves the most in interest.
segments.tr: - **Prioritaskan utang dengan suku bunga tertinggi.** Membayar lebih dari minimum pada kartu dengan APR tertinggi umumnya paling menghemat bunga.

segments.src: - **Look at balance transfer or consolidation options carefully.** Introductory 0 percent offers can help, but transfer fees, the length of the promotional period, and the rate that applies afterward all matter.
segments.tr: - **Perhatikan opsi transfer saldo atau konsolidasi dengan cermat.** Penawaran 0 persen perkenalan bisa membantu, tetapi biaya transfer, panjang periode promosi, dan suku bunga yang berlaku setelahnya semuanya penting.

segments.src: - **Contact your issuer if you are struggling.** Some issuers offer hardship programs. Nonprofit credit counseling agencies, including members of the National Foundation for Credit Counseling, can also help build a repayment plan.
segments.tr: - **Hubungi penerbit Anda jika Anda kesulitan.** Beberapa penerbit menawarkan program kesulitan keuangan. Lembaga konseling kredit nirlaba, termasuk anggota National Foundation for Credit Counseling, juga dapat membantu membangun rencana pembayaran kembali.

segments.src: - **Use alerts and autopay for at least the minimum.** A missed payment can bring late fees and a penalty rate, and it can hurt your credit score.
segments.tr: - **Gunakan peringatan dan pembayaran otomatis setidaknya untuk pembayaran minimum.** Pembayaran yang terlewat dapat membawa biaya keterlambatan dan suku bunga penalti, dan itu dapat merusak skor kredit Anda.

segments.src: - **Consider a smaller January.** A few gift-giving traditions, such as homemade gifts, shared experiences, or a set exchange, can lower the total without lowering the spirit of the season.
segments.tr: - **Pertimbangkan Januari yang lebih hemat.** Beberapa tradisi pemberian hadiah, seperti hadiah buatan sendiri, pengalaman bersama, atau pertukaran yang ditetapkan, dapat menurunkan total tanpa menurunkan semangat musim liburan.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang lebih besar

segments.tr: Rekor saldo kartu adalah produk dari beberapa kekuatan yang tumpang tindih: harga yang lebih tinggi, ekonomi yang lebih besar, pengeluaran konsumen yang tangguh, dan biaya pinjaman yang tetap jauh di atas posisi terendah era pandemi.

segments.src: For many households, the numbers are manageable.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak rumah tangga, angka-angka tersebut dapat dikelola.

segments.src: For others, particularly those carrying balances month to month at rates above 20 percent, the holiday season can deepen a cycle that is hard to escape.
segments.tr: Bagi yang lain, terutama mereka yang membawa saldo dari bulan ke bulan dengan suku bunga di atas 20 persen, musim liburan dapat memperdalam siklus yang sulit untuk dihindari.

segments.tr: Saldo tinggi, pinjaman mahal, dan tunggakan meningkat di beberapa kelompok.

segments.tr: Keluarga yang memasuki bulan Desember dengan rencana, pandangan yang jelas tentang suku bunga mereka, dan batas yang realistis berada dalam posisi terbaik untuk memulai tahun baru tanpa beban utang yang berat.

ja.title: 膨れ上がるクレジットカード残高：このホリデーシーズン、家計にとって記録的なカード残高は何を意味するのか

segments.src: Every November, the same two things collide: retailers roll out their biggest sales of the year, and households take stock of how much room they really have in their budgets.
segments.tr: 毎年11月になると、小売業者が年間最大のセールを展開する一方で、各家庭が家計にどれだけの余裕があるかを再確認するという、同じ2つの出来事が重なります。

segments.src: This year, the backdrop is a credit card debt load that has repeatedly set new records.
segments.tr: 今年の背景にあるのは、繰り返し新記録を更新しているクレジットカードの負債額です。

segments.src: Here is what the Federal Reserve Bank of New York's household debt data show, how card interest rates compare with earlier years, and what it all means for families heading into December.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク連邦準備銀行の家計負債データが何を示しているのか、カードの金利が以前と比べてどうなのか、そして12月を迎える家族にとってそれが何を意味するのかを解説します。

segments.src: ## What the New York Fed data show
segments.tr: ## ニューヨーク連銀のデータが示すもの

segments.src: The New York Fed's Center for Microeconomic Data publishes the *Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit*, based on anonymized credit bureau records.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク連銀のミクロ経済データセンターは、匿名化された信用調査機関の記録に基づき、『家計負債・信用四半期報告書（Quarterly Report on Household Debt and Credit）』を発行しています。

segments.src: It is one of the most widely cited gauges of how American households are borrowing.
segments.tr: これは、アメリカの家計がどのように借り入れを行っているかを示す、最も広く引用されている指標の1つです。

segments.src: Some of the broad patterns in recent reports:
segments.tr: 最近の報告書に見られる全体的な傾向は以下の通りです。

segments.src: - **Total household debt has climbed steadily.** In the third quarter of 2025, the report put total household debt at roughly $18.6 trillion, with mortgages making up the largest share.
segments.tr: - **家計負債総額は着実に増加しています。** 2025年第3四半期の報告書では、家計負債総額は約18.6兆ドルとされており、その中で住宅ローンが最大の割合を占めています。

segments.src: - **Credit card balances sit above $1.2 trillion.** Balances crossed the $1 trillion mark in 2023 and have stayed above it since. Third-quarter 2025 figures were around $1.23 trillion.
segments.tr: - **クレジットカード残高は1.2兆ドルを超えています。** 残高は2023年に1兆ドルの大台を突破し、それ以来その水準を維持しています。2025年第3四半期の数値は約1.23兆ドルでした。

segments.src: - **Balances follow a seasonal rhythm.** Card balances usually dip in the first quarter, as people pay down holiday spending with tax refunds and bonuses, then rise through the year and peak around the end of the year.
segments.tr: - **残高には季節的なリズムがあります。** カード残高は通常、人々が税金の還付金やボーナスでホリデーシーズンの支出を返済するため第1四半期に減少し、その後年間を通じて上昇し、年末にかけてピークに達します。

segments.src: Readers should check the most recent release on the New York Fed's website for current figures.
segments.tr: 読者は、最新の数値についてニューヨーク連銀のウェブサイトで最新のリリースを確認してください。

segments.src: The report is updated each quarter, and the numbers above are best read as a snapshot of the trend rather than the latest data point.
segments.tr: この報告書は四半期ごとに更新されるため、上記の数値は最新のデータポイントというよりも、傾向のスナップショットとして捉えるのが最適です。

segments.src: ### Records in dollars are not always records in strain
segments.tr: ### ドル建ての記録が必ずしも負担の記録とは限らない

segments.src: A large share of the "record" headlines reflects simple arithmetic.
segments.tr: 「記録的」という見出しの大部分は、単純な算術を反映したものです。

segments.src: Prices are higher than they were a few years ago, the population has grown, and incomes have risen in nominal terms.
segments.tr: 物価は数年前よりも高く、人口は増加し、名目所得も上昇しています。

segments.src: A bigger economy tends to carry bigger balances.
segments.tr: 経済が大きくなれば、残高も大きくなる傾向があります。

segments.src: Many cardholders also pay their bills in full every month, so a rising balance total does not automatically mean more households are in trouble.
segments.tr: また、多くのカード利用者は毎月全額を支払っているため、残高合計が増加しているからといって、困窮している世帯が自動的に増えているわけではありません。

segments.src: The more telling signals sit underneath the headline number.
segments.tr: より重要なシグナルは、見出しの数字の裏側に隠れています。

segments.src: These include the share of balances that are delinquent, how many borrowers carry a balance from month to month, and how fast new delinquencies are appearing.
segments.tr: これには、延滞している残高の割合、月をまたいで残高を持ち越す借り手の数、そして新たな延滞がどれくらいの速さで発生しているかなどが含まれます。

segments.src: ## Delinquencies: where the stress shows up
segments.tr: ## 延滞：ストレスが表れる場所

segments.src: The New York Fed also tracks how many borrowers fall behind on payments.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク連銀は、支払いが遅れている借り手の数も追跡しています。

segments.src: Credit cards have consistently shown some of the highest delinquency transition rates among major debt types.
segments.tr: クレジットカードは、主要な負債タイプの中で一貫して高い延滞移行率を示しています。

segments.src: In recent reports, a meaningful share of card balances moved into serious delinquency (90 or more days past due) within a year.
segments.tr: 最近の報告書では、カード残高のかなりの割合が1年以内に深刻な延滞（90日以上の支払い遅延）に陥っています。

segments.src: That share is higher than the period just before the pandemic.
segments.tr: その割合は、パンデミック直前の期間よりも高くなっています。

segments.src: Younger borrowers and those in lower-income areas have generally shown more strain than older and higher-income groups.
segments.tr: 一般的に、若い借り手や低所得地域の借り手は、高齢者や高所得グループよりも大きなストレスを示しています。

segments.src: That uneven pattern matters.
segments.tr: その不均一なパターンが重要です。

segments.src: Overall averages can look manageable while a sizeable group of households is stretched thin.
segments.tr: 全体的な平均値は管理可能に見えても、かなりの数の世帯が家計を圧迫されている可能性があります。

segments.src: ## How card interest rates compare with past years
segments.tr: ## カード金利と過去数年の比較

segments.src: The cost of carrying a balance is where the story gets more pressing.
segments.tr: 残高を持ち越すコストこそが、この話のより切迫した部分です。

segments.src: Federal Reserve data on interest rates for credit card accounts that are assessed interest have shown average rates in the low 20-percent range in recent years.
segments.tr: 利息が発生するクレジットカード口座の金利に関する連邦準備制度のデータによると、近年、平均金利は20％台前半で推移しています。

segments.src: Industry trackers report averages near 20 percent for new offers.
segments.tr: 業界の調査機関は、新規のオファーにおける平均金利が20％に近いと報告しています。

segments.src: By comparison:
segments.tr: 比較すると以下の通りです。

segments.src: - In the years after the 2008 financial crisis and through the 2010s, average card rates were typically in the low-to-mid teens.
segments.tr: - 2008年の金融危機後の数年間から2010年代にかけて、カードの平均金利は通常10％台前半から半ばでした。

segments.src: - In 2021, when the Fed held its benchmark rate near zero, the average rate on interest-bearing accounts dipped to roughly 14 to 15 percent.
segments.tr: - 連邦準備制度理事会（FRB）が基準金利をゼロ近くに維持していた2021年には、利息が発生する口座の平均金利は約14〜15％まで低下しました。

segments.src: - After the Fed began raising rates sharply in 2022, card APRs followed. Most cards carry variable rates tied to the prime rate, so they adjust quickly when the Fed moves.
segments.tr: - FRBが2022年に急激な利上げを開始した後、カードのAPR（年率）もそれに追随しました。ほとんどのカードはプライムレートに連動した変動金利を採用しているため、FRBが動くとすぐに調整されます。

segments.src: Card APRs have eased only slightly from their peak, even as the Fed has trimmed its benchmark rate.
segments.tr: FRBが基準金利を引き下げたにもかかわらず、カードのAPRはピーク時からわずかにしか低下していません。

segments.src: Because issuers set their own margins above the prime rate, a rate cut does not translate into a matching drop for cardholders.
segments.tr: 発行会社はプライムレートに上乗せする独自の利ざやを設定しているため、利下げがそのままカード利用者の金利低下につながるわけではありません。

segments.src: ### What a 21 percent APR means in practice
segments.tr: ### 21％のAPRが実際に意味すること

segments.src: Consider a household carrying a $5,000 balance at an APR of about 21 percent.
segments.tr: 約21％のAPRで5,000ドルの残高を抱える世帯を考えてみましょう。

segments.src: Making only a minimum payment, interest alone could add roughly $85 to $90 a month early on.
segments.tr: 最低支払い額のみを支払う場合、初期段階では利息だけで毎月約85ドルから90ドルが加算される可能性があります。

segments.src: The balance falls slowly, and the payoff stretches across many years.
segments.tr: 残高はゆっくりとしか減らず、完済までには何年もかかります。

segments.src: At a rate of 14 percent, the same balance would cost noticeably less in interest each month.
segments.tr: 金利が14％であれば、同じ残高でも毎月の利息負担は目に見えて少なくなります。

segments.src: The gap is small in any single month, but it compounds into hundreds or thousands of dollars over time.
segments.tr: 1ヶ月で見ればわずかな差ですが、時間が経つにつれて数百ドル、数千ドルもの差に膨れ上がります。

segments.src: ## Why the holidays raise the stakes
segments.tr: ## なぜホリデーシーズンにリスクが高まるのか

segments.src: Seasonal spending adds pressure at an already tight time.
segments.tr: 季節的な支出は、ただでさえ厳しい時期にさらなる圧力を加えます。

segments.src: A few factors stand out:
segments.tr: いくつかの要因が際立っています。

segments.src: 1. **Holiday spending is large and concentrated.** The National Retail Federation and other groups have projected total holiday retail sales in the trillions of dollars in recent seasons. Much of that lands on cards over a few weeks.
segments.tr: 1. **ホリデーシーズンの支出は大きく、集中しています。** 全米小売業協会などの団体は、近年のホリデーシーズンの小売売上高総額が数兆ドルに達すると予測しています。その多くが数週間のうちにカード決済されます。

segments.src: 2. **Buy now, pay later is part of the mix.** Installment plans can spread out costs, but they add another set of due dates on top of card payments.
segments.tr: 2. **「今買って後で払う（BNPL）」も要因の一つです。** 分割払いプランはコストを分散させることができますが、カードの支払いに加えて新たな支払い期限が追加されることになります。

segments.src: 3. **Prices remain a concern.** Even with inflation cooler than its 2022 peak, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher costs for groceries, housing, insurance, and utilities. Less slack in the monthly budget leaves less room for gifts, travel, and hosting.
segments.tr: 3. **物価への懸念は続いています。** インフレ率は2022年のピーク時より落ち着いているものの、多くの世帯は食料品、住宅、保険、光熱費の高騰による累積的な影響を依然として感じています。月々の家計に余裕がなければ、ギフト、旅行、パーティーに回せる予算は少なくなります。

segments.src: 4. **January bills arrive later.** Holiday charges often appear on statements in December and January, which is when many families first see the full total.
segments.tr: 4. **1月の請求書は後から届きます。** ホリデーシーズンの利用分は12月や1月の明細に記載されることが多く、その時点で初めて多くの家族が合計金額を目の当たりにすることになります。

segments.src: ## What families heading into December can do
segments.tr: ## 12月を迎える家族ができること

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic, and none of it is personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: これらはパニックになる理由ではなく、また個人的な財務アドバイスでもありません。

segments.src: But a few practical steps are widely recommended by consumer finance educators and nonprofit credit counselors:
segments.tr: しかし、消費者金融の教育者や非営利の信用カウンセラーによって広く推奨されている実践的なステップがいくつかあります。

segments.src: - **Set a spending ceiling before shopping.** Decide on a total for gifts, food, and travel, and work backward to per-person amounts.
segments.tr: - **買い物をする前に支出の上限を設定する。** ギフト、食費、旅行の合計額を決め、そこから一人当たりの金額を逆算してください。

segments.src: - **Know your APR and your balance.** Check your latest statement. If you already carry a balance, new holiday purchases will start accruing interest right away, because the grace period usually applies only when the balance is paid in full.
segments.tr: - **自分のAPRと残高を把握する。** 最新の明細を確認してください。すでに残高がある場合、ホリデーシーズンの新規購入分にはすぐに利息が発生し始めます。なぜなら、猶予期間は通常、残高が全額支払われている場合にのみ適用されるからです。

segments.src: - **Prioritize the highest-rate debt.** Paying more than the minimum on the highest-APR card generally saves the most in interest.
segments.tr: - **最も金利の高い負債を優先する。** APRが最も高いカードで最低支払い額以上の返済を行うことが、一般的に最も利息の節約になります。

segments.src: - **Look at balance transfer or consolidation options carefully.** Introductory 0 percent offers can help, but transfer fees, the length of the promotional period, and the rate that applies afterward all matter.
segments.tr: - **残高移行や一本化の選択肢を慎重に検討する。** 0％の導入キャンペーンは役立つ可能性がありますが、移行手数料、キャンペーン期間の長さ、その後適用される金利のすべてが重要です。

segments.src: - **Contact your issuer if you are struggling.** Some issuers offer hardship programs. Nonprofit credit counseling agencies, including members of the National Foundation for Credit Counseling, can also help build a repayment plan.
segments.tr: - **苦しい場合は発行会社に連絡する。** 一部の発行会社は困窮者支援プログラムを提供しています。全米信用カウンセリング財団（National Foundation for Credit Counseling）のメンバーを含む非営利の信用カウンセリング機関も、返済計画の策定を支援してくれます。

segments.src: - **Use alerts and autopay for at least the minimum.** A missed payment can bring late fees and a penalty rate, and it can hurt your credit score.
segments.tr: - **少なくとも最低支払い額についてはアラートと自動引き落としを利用する。** 支払いを忘れると延滞料やペナルティ金利が発生し、信用スコアに悪影響を及ぼす可能性があります。

segments.src: - **Consider a smaller January.** A few gift-giving traditions, such as homemade gifts, shared experiences, or a set exchange, can lower the total without lowering the spirit of the season.
segments.tr: - **1月を控えめにする検討をする。** 手作りのギフト、共有体験、プレゼント交換など、いくつかのギフト贈呈の伝統を取り入れることで、季節の精神を損なうことなく合計金額を抑えることができます。

segments.src: ## The bigger picture
segments.tr: ## 全体像

segments.src: Record card balances are the product of several overlapping forces: higher prices, a larger economy, resilient consumer spending, and borrowing costs that remain well above their pandemic-era lows.
segments.tr: 記録的なカード残高は、物価上昇、経済規模の拡大、底堅い個人消費、そしてパンデミック時の低水準を大きく上回る借入コストという、いくつかの重なり合う要因の結果です。

segments.src: For many households, the numbers are manageable.
segments.tr: 多くの世帯にとって、その数字は管理可能な範囲です。

segments.src: For others, particularly those carrying balances month to month at rates above 20 percent, the holiday season can deepen a cycle that is hard to escape.
segments.tr: しかし、特に20％を超える金利で月々残高を持ち越している人々にとっては、ホリデーシーズンが抜け出しにくい悪循環を深める可能性があります。

segments.src: The most useful way to read the New York Fed's data is not as a single alarming figure but as a set of trends.
segments.tr: ニューヨーク連銀のデータを読み解く最も有益な方法は、単一の驚くべき数字としてではなく、一連の傾向として捉えることです。

segments.src: Balances are high, borrowing is expensive, and delinquencies are elevated in some groups.
segments.tr: 残高は高く、借り入れは高コストであり、一部のグループでは延滞率が上昇しています。

segments.src: Families who go into December with a plan, a clear view of their rates, and a realistic limit are in the best position to start the new year without a heavy debt hangover.
segments.tr: 計画を立て、金利を明確に把握し、現実的な制限を設けて12月を迎える家族は、重い負債の二日酔いなしに新年をスタートさせるための最善の立場にあります。

segments.tr: 引用された数値は、ニューヨーク連邦準備銀行および連邦準備制度が公開している報告書から抽出されたものであり、概算です。

segments.tr: ご自身の状況に関するガイダンスについては、資格のある専門家にご相談ください。*

segments.tr: Eine größere Wirtschaft neigt dazu, höhere Salden mit sich zu führen.

segments.src: Many cardholders also pay their bills in full every month, so a rising balance total does not automatically mean more households are in trouble.
segments.tr: Viele Karteninhaber bezahlen ihre Rechnungen auch jeden Monat vollständig, daher bedeutet ein steigender Gesamtsaldo nicht automatisch, dass mehr Haushalte in Schwierigkeiten stecken.

segments.src: The more telling signals sit underneath the headline number.
segments.tr: Die aussagekräftigeren Signale liegen unter der Schlagzeilenzahl.

segments.src: These include the share of balances that are delinquent, how many borrowers carry a balance from month to month, and how fast new delinquencies are appearing.
segments.tr: Dazu gehören der Anteil der überfälligen Salden, wie viele Kreditnehmer einen Saldo von Monat zu Monat mit sich führen und wie schnell neue Zahlungsverzüge auftreten.

segments.src: ## Delinquencies: where the stress shows up
segments.tr: ## Zahlungsverzüge: Wo sich der Stress zeigt

segments.src: The New York Fed also tracks how many borrowers fall behind on payments.
segments.tr: Die New York Fed verfolgt auch, wie viele Kreditnehmer mit Zahlungen in Verzug geraten.

segments.src: Credit cards have consistently shown some of the highest delinquency transition rates among major debt types.
segments.tr: Kreditkarten haben bei den wichtigsten Schuldenarten durchweg einige der höchsten Übergangsraten bei Zahlungsverzügen gezeigt.

segments.src: In recent reports, a meaningful share of card balances moved into serious delinquency (90 or more days past due) within a year.
segments.tr: In jüngsten Berichten geriet ein bedeutender Teil der Kartensalden innerhalb eines Jahres in ernsthaften Zahlungsverzug (90 oder mehr Tage überfällig).

segments.src: That share is higher than the period just before the pandemic.
segments.tr: Dieser Anteil ist höher als in der Zeit kurz vor der Pandemie.

segments.src: Younger borrowers and those in lower-income areas have generally shown more strain than older and higher-income groups.
segments.tr: Jüngere Kreditnehmer und diejenigen in einkommensschwächeren Gebieten haben im Allgemeinen eine stärkere Belastung gezeigt als ältere und einkommensstärkere Gruppen.

segments.src: That uneven pattern matters.
segments.tr: Dieses ungleiche Muster ist wichtig.

segments.src: Overall averages can look manageable while a sizeable group of households is stretched thin.
segments.tr: Gesamtdurchschnitte können überschaubar aussehen, während eine beträchtliche Gruppe von Haushalten finanziell stark beansprucht ist.

segments.src: ## How card interest rates compare with past years
segments.tr: ## Wie Kreditkartenzinssätze im Vergleich zu vergangenen Jahren abschneiden

segments.src: The cost of carrying a balance is where the story gets more pressing.
segments.tr: Die Kosten für das Mitführen eines Saldos sind der Punkt, an dem die Geschichte dringlicher wird.

segments.src: Federal Reserve data on interest rates for credit card accounts that are assessed interest have shown average rates in the low 20-percent range in recent years.
segments.tr: Daten der Federal Reserve zu Zinssätzen für Kreditkartenkonten, auf die Zinsen erhoben werden, haben in den letzten Jahren durchschnittliche Zinssätze im niedrigen 20-Prozent-Bereich gezeigt.

segments.src: Industry trackers report averages near 20 percent for new offers.
segments.tr: Branchenbeobachter melden Durchschnittswerte von fast 20 Prozent für neue Angebote.

segments.src: By comparison:
segments.tr: Im Vergleich dazu:

segments.src: - In the years after the 2008 financial crisis and through the 2010s, average card rates were typically in the low-to-mid teens.
segments.tr: - In den Jahren nach der Finanzkrise 2008 und während der 2010er Jahre lagen die durchschnittlichen Kartenzinsen typischerweise im niedrigen bis mittleren Zehnerbereich.

segments.src: - In 2021, when the Fed held its benchmark rate near zero, the average rate on interest-bearing accounts dipped to roughly 14 to 15 percent.
segments.tr: - Im Jahr 2021, als die Fed ihren Leitzins nahe null hielt, sank der durchschnittliche Zinssatz auf verzinsliche Konten auf etwa 14 bis 15 Prozent.

segments.src: - After the Fed began raising rates sharply in 2022, card APRs followed. Most cards carry variable rates tied to the prime rate, so they adjust quickly when the Fed moves.
segments.tr: - Nachdem die Fed 2022 begann, die Zinsen stark anzuheben, folgten die Karten-APRs. Die meisten Karten haben variable Zinssätze, die an den Leitzins gekoppelt sind, sodass sie sich schnell anpassen, wenn die Fed handelt.

segments.src: Card APRs have eased only slightly from their peak, even as the Fed has trimmed its benchmark rate.
segments.tr: Die Karten-APRs sind nur leicht von ihrem Höchststand gesunken, selbst als die Fed ihren Leitzins gesenkt hat.

segments.src: Because issuers set their own margins above the prime rate, a rate cut does not translate into a matching drop for cardholders.
segments.tr: Da die Emittenten ihre eigenen Margen über dem Leitzins festlegen, führt eine Zinssenkung nicht zu einem entsprechenden Rückgang für die Karteninhaber.

segments.src: ### What a 21 percent APR means in practice
segments.tr: ### Was ein APR von 21 Prozent in der Praxis bedeutet

segments.src: Consider a household carrying a $5,000 balance at an APR of about 21 percent.
segments.tr: Betrachten Sie einen Haushalt, der einen Saldo von 5.000 Dollar zu einem APR von etwa 21 Prozent mit sich führt.

segments.src: Making only a minimum payment, interest alone could add roughly $85 to $90 a month early on.
segments.tr: Wenn man nur eine Mindestzahlung leistet, könnten allein die Zinsen anfangs etwa 85 bis 90 Dollar pro Monat ausmachen.

segments.src: The balance falls slowly, and the payoff stretches across many years.
segments.tr: Der Saldo sinkt langsam, und die Rückzahlung erstreckt sich über viele Jahre.

segments.src: At a rate of 14 percent, the same balance would cost noticeably less in interest each month.
segments.tr: Bei einem Zinssatz von 14 Prozent würde derselbe Saldo jeden Monat spürbar weniger an Zinsen kosten.

segments.src: The gap is small in any single month, but it compounds into hundreds or thousands of dollars over time.
segments.tr: Die Lücke ist in jedem einzelnen Monat klein, aber sie summiert sich im Laufe der Zeit auf Hunderte oder Tausende von Dollar.

segments.src: ## Why the holidays raise the stakes
segments.tr: ## Warum die Feiertage den Einsatz erhöhen

segments.src: Seasonal spending adds pressure at an already tight time.
segments.tr: Saisonale Ausgaben erhöhen den Druck in einer ohnehin schon angespannten Zeit.

segments.src: A few factors stand out:
segments.tr: Einige Faktoren stechen hervor:

segments.src: 1. **Holiday spending is large and concentrated.** The National Retail Federation and other groups have projected total holiday retail sales in the trillions of dollars in recent seasons. Much of that lands on cards over a few weeks.
segments.tr: 1. **Weihnachtsausgaben sind groß und konzentriert.** Die National Retail Federation und andere Gruppen haben in den letzten Saisons die gesamten Weihnachtseinzelhandelsumsätze auf Billionen von Dollar geschätzt. Ein Großteil davon landet über wenige Wochen auf den Karten.

segments.src: 2. **Buy now, pay later is part of the mix.** Installment plans can spread out costs, but they add another set of due dates on top of card payments.
segments.tr: 2. **„Jetzt kaufen, später bezahlen“ ist Teil der Mischung.** Ratenzahlungspläne können die Kosten verteilen, aber sie fügen zusätzlich zu den Kartenzahlungen eine weitere Reihe von Fälligkeitsterminen hinzu.

segments.src: 3. **Prices remain a concern.** Even with inflation cooler than its 2022 peak, many households still feel the cumulative effect of higher costs for groceries, housing, insurance, and utilities. Less slack in the monthly budget leaves less room for gifts, travel, and hosting.
segments.tr: 3. **Preise bleiben ein Anliegen.** Auch wenn die Inflation kühler ist als ihr Höchststand von 2022, spüren viele Haushalte immer noch die kumulativen Auswirkungen höherer Kosten für Lebensmittel, Wohnen, Versicherungen und Versorgungsleistungen. Weniger Spielraum im monatlichen Budget lässt weniger Platz für Geschenke, Reisen und Bewirtung.

segments.src: 4. **January bills arrive later.** Holiday charges often appear on statements in December and January, which is when many families first see the full total.
segments.tr: 4. **Januar-Rechnungen kommen später.** Weihnachtsausgaben erscheinen oft auf Abrechnungen im Dezember und Januar, wenn viele Familien zum ersten Mal die volle Summe sehen.

segments.src: ## What families heading into December can do
segments.tr: ## Was Familien, die auf den Dezember zugehen, tun können

segments.src: None of this is a reason to panic, and none of it is personalized financial advice.
segments.tr: Nichts davon ist ein Grund zur Panik, und nichts davon ist eine personalisierte Finanzberatung.

segments.src: But a few practical steps are widely recommended by consumer finance educators and nonprofit credit counselors:
segments.tr: Aber einige praktische Schritte werden von Finanzpädagogen und gemeinnützigen Kreditberatern weithin empfohlen:

segments.src: - **Set a spending ceiling before shopping.** Decide on a total for gifts, food, and travel, and work backward to per-person amounts.
segments.tr: - **Setzen Sie eine Ausgabenobergrenze vor dem Einkaufen.** Entscheiden Sie sich für eine Gesamtsumme für Geschenke, Essen und Reisen und arbeiten Sie rückwärts zu Beträgen pro Person.

segments.src: - **Know your APR and your balance.** Check your latest statement. If you already carry a balance, new holiday purchases will start accruing interest right away, because the grace period usually applies only when the balance is paid in full.
segments.tr: - **Kennen Sie Ihren APR und Ihren Saldo.** Überprüfen Sie Ihre letzte Abrechnung. Wenn Sie bereits einen Saldo mit sich führen, werden für neue Weihnachtseinkäufe sofort Zinsen anfallen, da die zinsfreie Zeit normalerweise nur gilt, wenn der Saldo vollständig bezahlt ist.

segments.src: - **Prioritize the highest-rate debt.** Paying more than the minimum on the highest-APR card generally saves the most in interest.
segments.tr: - **Priorisieren Sie die Schulden mit dem höchsten Zinssatz.** Mehr als das Minimum auf der Karte mit dem höchsten APR zu zahlen, spart im Allgemeinen am meisten an Zinsen.

segments.src: - **Look at balance transfer or consolidation options carefully.** Introductory 0 percent offers can help, but transfer fees, the length of the promotional period, and the rate that applies afterward all matter.
segments.tr: - **Prüfen Sie Optionen für Saldoübertragungen oder Konsolidierung sorgfältig.** Einführende 0-Prozent-Angebote können helfen, aber Übertragungsgebühren, die Länge des Aktionszeitraums und der danach geltende Zinssatz sind alle wichtig.

segments.src: - **Contact your issuer if you are struggling.** Some issuers offer hardship programs. Nonprofit credit counseling agencies, including members of the National Foundation for Credit Counseling, can also help build a repayment plan.
segments.tr: - **Kontaktieren Sie Ihren Emittenten, wenn Sie Schwierigkeiten haben.** Einige Emittenten bieten Härtefallprogramme an. Gemeinnützige Kreditberatungsstellen, einschließlich Mitglieder der National Foundation for Credit Counseling, können ebenfalls helfen, einen Rückzahlungsplan zu erstellen.

segments.src: - **Use alerts and autopay for at least the minimum.** A missed payment can bring late fees and a penalty rate, and it can hurt your credit score.
segments.tr: - **Verwenden Sie Warnungen und automatische Zahlungen für mindestens das Minimum.** Eine verpasste Zahlung kann Verzugsgebühren und einen Strafzinssatz nach sich ziehen und kann Ihre Kreditwürdigkeit beeinträchtigen.

segments.src: - **Consider a smaller January.** A few gift-giving traditions, such as homemade gifts, shared experiences, or a set exchange, can lower the total without lowering the spirit of the season.
segments.tr: - **Erwägen Sie einen kleineren Januar.** Einige Traditionen des Schenkens, wie selbstgemachte Geschenke, gemeinsame Erlebnisse oder ein festgelegter Austausch, können die Gesamtsumme senken, ohne den Geist der Saison zu senken.

segments.src: ## The bigger picture
segments.tr: ## Das Gesamtbild

segments.src: Record card balances are the product of several overlapping forces: higher prices, a larger economy, resilient consumer spending, and borrowing costs that remain well above their pandemic-era lows.
segments.tr: Rekord-Kartensalden sind das Produkt mehrerer sich überschneidender Kräfte: höhere Preise, eine größere Wirtschaft, widerstandsfähige Verbraucherausgaben und Kreditkosten, die weit über ihren Tiefstständen aus der Pandemiezeit bleiben.

segments.src: For many households, the numbers are manageable.
segments.tr: Für viele Haushalte sind die Zahlen überschaubar.

segments.src: For others, particularly those carrying balances month to month at rates above 20 percent, the holiday season can deepen a cycle that is hard to escape.
segments.tr: Für andere, insbesondere diejenigen, die Salden von Monat zu Monat zu Zinssätzen über 20 Prozent mit sich führen, kann die Weihnachtszeit einen Kreislauf vertiefen, dem man nur schwer entkommen kann.

segments.src: The most useful way to read the New York Fed's data is not as a single alarming figure but as a set of trends.
segments.tr: Der nützlichste Weg, die Daten der New York Fed zu lesen, ist nicht als eine einzelne alarmierende Zahl, sondern als eine Reihe von Trends.

segments.src: Balances are high, borrowing is expensive, and delinquencies are elevated in some groups.
segments.tr: Die Salden sind hoch, die Kreditaufnahme ist teuer und die Zahlungsverzüge sind in einigen Gruppen erhöht.

segments.src: Families who go into December with a plan, a clear view of their rates, and a realistic limit are in the best position to start the new year without a heavy debt hangover.
segments.tr: Familien, die mit einem Plan, einem klaren Blick auf ihre Zinssätze und einem realistischen Limit in den Dezember gehen, sind in der besten Position, das neue Jahr ohne einen schweren Schuldenkater zu beginnen.
